evidence.quote: Day-old loaves go to half price at two in the afternoon
At close nobody is left to buy them

observations.why: Future-directed pricing rule stated as settled practice in present-tense generic form; the timing contrast with close reads as an abstract principle.

evidence.quote: the shelf card changes at two as well
so the price is never a surprise at the till

observations.why: Proposed future change to the shelf card, framed as a planned consequence; the 'never a surprise' clause generalizes to an abstract principle.
